mainImage.alt: Drone aerial view of a warehouse fire with thick smoke and visible flames. Representative image of the type of fire that occurred at the Raytheon building in Warner Robins, Georgia on April 13, 2026.
mainImage.caption: Representative image: Drone footage of a warehouse fire. The Raytheon building in Warner Robins, Georgia experienced a similar fire on April 13, 2026, with smoke visible from front windows.
